The body and caution align perfectly with EK 3.7.B.6, 3.7.B.4, 3.13.C.3, and 3.15.D.3, which emphasize using non-definitive language, referencing the parameter and population, and never accepting or proving the null hypothesis.

The caution correctly reflects 3.7.B.4: a test can never prove the null hypothesis true.
